dct_description_sm: The Gateway to Scientific Data will help ensure that the valuable data generated by Canadian researchers is more easily accessible so that it can be re-used for other research endeavours. With the ability to access and use data from a multitude of sources, researchers will be better positioned to turn research into discoveries and innovations.This initiative is an important part of NRC-CISTI's efforts to provide researchers with access to the information resources they need to remain at the forefront of research and development in Canada and around the world.
dct_title_s: National Research Council Canada - CISTI gateway to scientific data
